verdict.rationale: xAI documents automatic prompt caching for requests that share the same starting messages. The pricing docs publish a separate cached-input rate per model (e.g. grok-4.7: $0.50 cached vs $2.00 input per 1M tokens), which gives a clear cost reduction on repeated context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the latency benefit, cache-hit reporting and TTL/eligibility details in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can cut cost and latency on repeated context with documented prompt/prefix caching and its pricing

citations.quote: When consecutive requests share the same starting messages, the xAI API automatically caches them.
